notes: Tuition for non-EU students is not stated for this specific programme; the institution-wide instellingscollegegeld (EUR 10,360 for 2026-2027) is left out because the pages do not say it applies to this programme's non-EU applicants. The B2 Dutch language requirement quote comes from the Creative Business page but is the general rule stated on those pages for students with a foreign diploma; verify per programme.

evidence.quote: Students who have completed their prior education abroad must therefore demonstrate Dutch language proficiency at B2 level (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages).
This can be done by obtaining an NT2 (Dutch as a Second Language) Programme II certificate (reading, writing, speaking and listening components).

note.fr: Votre diplôme étranger doit être validé par Inholland ; envoyez votre diplôme, votre relevé de notes et, si nécessaire, une traduction assermentée via Selfservice.
note.en: Your foreign diploma must be validated by Inholland; send your diploma, transcript and, if necessary, a sworn translation via Selfservice.

evidence.quote: De CSA beoordeelt alleen diploma’s nadat je een aanmelding via Studielink hebt gedaan en je diploma, cijferlijst, en, indien nodig, een vertaling van een beëdigd vertaler, hebt geüpload in Selfservice.

note.fr: Les candidats internationaux doivent de préférence s'inscrire avant le 1 mai ; la procédure d'inscription peut prendre plus de trois mois.
note.en: International applicants should preferably enrol before 1 May; the enrolment procedure can take well over three months.

evidence.quote: We recommend the following enrolment deadline dates: Dutch students by 1 August EU students by 1 August Non-EU students by 1 May
Please note that the enrolment procedure for international applicants can take well over three months, so please apply as early as possible.
